# Box3D (Erin Catto) — 3D rigid body physics.
# Upstream: https://github.com/erincatto/box3d  (MIT)
# Core library only — no samples / unit tests / docs.

if((CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU") OR (CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang"))
  remove_c_and_cxx_flag(
    "-Wextra"
    "-Wall"
    "-Wunused"
  )
endif()

if(WIN32)
  add_definitions(-D_USE_MATH_DEFINES)
  add_definitions(-DNOMINMAX)
endif()

set(INC
  include
  src
)

set(INC_SYS
)

set(SRC
  src/aabb.c
  src/arena_allocator.c
  src/bitset.c
  src/block_allocator.c
  src/body.c
  src/broad_phase.c
  src/capsule.c
  src/compound.c
  src/constraint_graph.c
  src/contact.c
  src/contact_solver.c
  src/convex_manifold.c
  src/core.c
  src/distance.c
  src/distance_joint.c
  src/dynamic_tree.c
  src/height_field.c
  src/hull.c
  src/id_pool.c
  src/island.c
  src/joint.c
  src/manifold.c
  src/math_functions.c
  src/mesh.c
  src/mesh_contact.c
  src/motor_joint.c
  src/mover.c
  src/name_cache.c
  src/parallel_for.c
  src/parallel_joint.c
  src/physics_world.c
  src/prismatic_joint.c
  src/recording.c
  src/recording_replay.c
  src/revolute_joint.c
  src/scheduler.c
  src/sensor.c
  src/shape.c
  src/simd.c
  src/solver.c
  src/solver_set.c
  src/sphere.c
  src/spherical_joint.c
  src/table.c
  src/timer.c
  src/triangle_manifold.c
  src/types.c
  src/weld_joint.c
  src/wheel_joint.c
  src/world_snapshot.c

  include/box3d/base.h
  include/box3d/box3d.h
  include/box3d/collision.h
  include/box3d/config.h
  include/box3d/constants.h
  include/box3d/id.h
  include/box3d/math_functions.h
  include/box3d/types.h
)

set(LIB
)

blender_add_lib(extern_box3d "${SRC}" "${INC}" "${INC_SYS}" "${LIB}")
add_library(bf::extern::box3d ALIAS extern_box3d)

set_target_properties(extern_box3d PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 17
  C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
  C_EXTENSIONS YES
)

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(extern_box3d PRIVATE /wd4244 /wd4267 /wd4305 /wd4018 /wd4820 /wd5045)
endif()

target_include_directories(extern_box3d PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
)
